name: lash.main_red
doc: Wait for the next completed run on lash main with databaseId above after_run. Defaults to the CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml, named CI) and workflow_dispatch event, excluding push runs. Polls every interval seconds (default 120). Reports failed job names and IDs plus test identifiers extracted from failed job logs. Pass run_id as after_run to wait for the next run.
